message: No treatment effect can be estimated.   This is because Design Restriction 1 in de Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2024) is not satisfied in the data, given the options requested.   This may be due to the fact that groups' period-one treatment is continuous, or takes a large number of values, and you have not specified the continuous option.   If so, you can try to specify this option.   If the issue persists even with this option, this means that all groups experience their first treatment change at the same date.   In this situation, estimators of de Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2024) cannot be used.
